entries.sourceTitle: NIH ODS Vitamin B6 health professional fact sheet, Table 3
entries.sourceBasis: Official NIH summary of the 1998 reference.
entries.note: The older adult UL covers food and supplements. It is not an intake goal or proof of safe use below this amount.
EFSA's adult UL includes dietary and supplemental intake and all B6 vitamers, including during pregnancy and lactation. It is not a personal dose recommendation.

entries.sourceTitle: Health Product InfoWatch: June 2026, Vitamin B6 health products and peripheral neuropathy
entries.sourceBasis: Official safety brief describing the natural-health-product monograph update.
entries.note: The notice describes a possible association with peripheral neuropathy and a warning for B6-containing natural health products. This is not a universal UL or a toxicity diagnosis.

entries.sourceTitle: Proposal to modify the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients (vitamin B6)
entries.sourceBasis: Notice of Proposal, Table 1 and implementation/enforcement section; consultation closes January 20, 2027.
entries.note: Proposes a 10 mg per-serving maximum and cautionary labelling above 2 mg per serving. This is a supplemented-food proposal, not an enacted universal daily-intake limit.
